PROCEDURE trace_data_history IS
 r_key recordgroup;
 c_key groupcolumn;

 r_items recordgroup;
 c_table groupcolumn;
 c_colmn groupcolumn;
 c_audit groupcolumn;

 r_hist recordgroup;
 c_column groupcolumn;
 c_oldval groupcolumn;
 c_newval groupcolumn;
 c_userid groupcolumn;
 c_progrm groupcolumn;
 c_action groupcolumn;
 c_datets groupcolumn;

 v_oneblck boolean;
 v_oneitem boolean;
 v_key number;
 v_btn number;
 v_cnt number;
 v_base varchar2(50);
 v_block varchar2(50) := :system.cursor_block;
 v_column varchar2(30);
 v_item varchar2(50) := substr(:system.cursor_item,length(v_block)+2);
 v_query varchar2(32000);
 v_rowid rowid;

 procedure find_block_table is
 begin
 v_rowid := null;
 if get_block_property(v_block,QUERY_DATA_SOURCE_TYPE) != 'TABLE' then
 if v_oneblck then
 show_error('19101'); -- not a base table block
 else
 v_base := null;
 end if;
 else
 v_base := get_block_property(v_block,QUERY_DATA_SOURCE_NAME);
 end if;

 if v_base is null then
 if v_oneblck then
 show_error('19101'); -- not a base table block
 end if;
 else
 select count(1) into v_cnt
 from all_tab_columns
 where column_name = 'AUDIT_KEY'
 and table_name in (v_base,v_base||'_AUDIT');
 if v_cnt < 2 then
 if v_oneblck then
 show_error('19102'); -- table not audited.
 end if;
 else
 v_rowid := name_in(v_block||'.rowid');
 if v_rowid is null and v_oneblck then
 show_error('19103'); -- not retrieved directly from database
 end if;
 end if;
 end if;
 end;

 procedure find_key_value is
 begin
 v_key := null;
 if get_item_property(v_block||'.'||v_item, BASE_TABLE) != 'TRUE' then
 if v_oneitem then
 show_error('19104'); -- item is not base table
 end if;
 else
 v_column := nvl(get_item_property(v_block||'.'||v_item,COLUMN_NAME),v_item);
 v_query := 'select audit_key from '||v_base||
 ' where rowid = '''||rowidtochar(v_rowid)||'''';
 v_cnt := populate_group_with_query(r_key,v_query);
 if v_cnt != 0 then
 message(v_cnt);
 end if;
 v_key := get_group_number_cell(c_key,1);
 end if;
 end;

 procedure add_to_group is
 begin
 add_group_row(r_items,1);
 set_group_char_cell (c_table,1,v_base);
 set_group_char_cell (c_colmn,1,v_column);
 set_group_number_cell(c_audit,1,v_key);
 end;

begin
 :global.history_return_item := v_block||'.'||v_item;

 r_items := find_group('HISTORY_ITEMS');
 if not id_null(r_items) then
 delete_group(r_items);
 end if;
 r_items := create_group('HISTORY_ITEMS');
 c_table := add_group_column(r_items,'TABLE',CHAR_COLUMN,30);
 c_colmn := add_group_column(r_items,'COLUMN',CHAR_COLUMN,30);
 c_audit := add_group_column(r_items,'KEY',NUMBER_COLUMN);

 r_key := find_group('KEY');
 if not id_null(r_key) then
 delete_group(r_key);
 end if;
 r_key := create_group('KEY');
 c_key := add_group_column(r_key,'AUDIT_KEY',NUMBER_COLUMN);

 r_hist := find_group('DATA_HISTORY');
 if not id_null(r_hist) then
 delete_group(r_hist);
 end if;
 r_hist := create_group('DATA_HISTORY');
 c_column := add_group_column(r_hist,'COLUMN_NAME', CHAR_COLUMN,30);
 c_oldval := add_group_column(r_hist,'OLD_VALUE', CHAR_COLUMN,240);
 c_newval := add_group_column(r_hist,'NEW_VALUE', CHAR_COLUMN,240);
 c_userid := add_group_column(r_hist,'USER_ID', CHAR_COLUMN,30);
 c_progrm := add_group_column(r_hist,'PROGRAM_ID', CHAR_COLUMN,30);
 c_action := add_group_column(r_hist,'ACTION_CODE', CHAR_COLUMN,30);
 c_datets := add_group_column(r_hist,'AUDIT_INSERT_DATS',DATE_COLUMN);

 v_btn := show_alert('HISTORY_ALERT');
 if v_btn = ALERT_BUTTON3 then
 raise form_trigger_failure;
 end if;

 if v_btn = ALERT_BUTTON1 then
 v_oneblck := true;
 v_oneitem := true;
 elsif v_btn = ALERT_BUTTON2 then
 v_oneitem := false;
 v_oneblck := not (get_block_property(v_block,records_displayed) = 1);
 if not v_oneblck then
 v_block := get_form_property(:system.current_form,first_block);
 end if;
 end if;

 loop
 find_block_table;
 if v_rowid is not null and
 (v_oneblck or get_block_property(v_block,records_displayed) = 1) then
 if not v_oneitem then
 v_item := get_block_property(v_block,first_item);
 end if;
 loop
 find_key_value;
 if v_key is not null then
 add_to_group;
 end if;
 exit when v_oneitem or v_item = get_block_property(v_block,last_item);
 v_item := get_item_property(v_block||'.'||v_item,nextitem);
 end loop;
 end if;
 exit when v_oneblck or v_block = get_form_property(:system.current_form,last_block); 
 v_block := get_block_property(v_block,nextblock);
 end loop;
 
 v_query := null;
 for i in 1 .. get_group_row_count(r_items)loop
 if v_query is not null then
 v_query := v_query||' UNION ';
 end if;
 v_query := v_query||
 'SELECT COLUMN_NAME,OLD_VALUE,NEW_VALUE,USER_ID,'||
 'PROGRAM_ID,ACTION_CODE,AUDIT_INSERT_DATS FROM '||
 get_group_char_cell(c_table,i)||'_AUDIT'||
 ' WHERE UPPER(COLUMN_NAME) = '''||get_group_char_cell(c_colmn,i)||''''||
 ' AND AUDIT_KEY = '||to_char(get_group_number_cell(c_audit,i));
 end loop;
 v_query := v_query||' ORDER BY 7 DESC';
 v_cnt := populate_group_with_query(r_hist,v_query);
 if v_cnt != 0 then
 if v_cnt = 1403 then
 show_error('19105'); -- no audit details found
 end if;
 message(v_cnt);
 end if;

 go_block('data_history');

 for i in 1 .. get_group_row_count(r_hist) loop
 :data_history.column_name := initcap(translate(
 get_group_char_cell(c_column,i),'_',' '));
 :data_history.old_value := get_group_char_cell(c_oldval,i);
 :data_history.new_value := get_group_char_cell(c_newval,i);
 :data_history.action_code := get_group_char_cell(c_action,i);
 :data_history.user_id := get_group_char_cell(c_userid,i);
 :data_history.program_id := get_group_char_cell(c_progrm,i);
 :data_history.audit_dats := get_group_date_cell(c_datets,i);
 create_record;
 end loop;
 go_record('1');

exception
 when others then handle_error;
end;

 procedure format_error is

 temp_pos number;

 temp_format := upper(GET_ITEM_PROPERTY(:system.cursor_item,FORMAT_MASK));
 -- remove FM or FX format prefix
 if substr(temp_format,1,2) in ('FX','FM') then
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,3);

 -- remove double quotes and change 0 to 9
 temp_format := translate(temp_format,'0"','9');
 -- change HH24 to HH

 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'HH'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 4);

 exit when temp_pos = 0;
 temp_format := substr(temp_format,1,temp_pos-1)||'YY'||
 substr(temp_format,temp_pos + 2);
 end loop;
 show_error('0022',temp_format );
 check_package_failure;
 end;

 then
